title: UX Researcher
summary: A UX researcher studies how people use a product, through interviews, usability tests and surveys, so the team builds the right thing. You sit with product designers and product managers, plan studies, talk to users across India, and turn what you learn into clear findings the team acts on.
dailyDuties: Plan studies with product managers and designers
Recruit participants and run user interviews
Run moderated and unmoderated usability tests
Synthesise notes into themes and insights
Present findings and track what the team changed
Keep the research repository up to date

skills.expectation: Plan research studies that answer product and design questions
Recruit and run one-to-one user interviews, including in Indian languages where needed
Run moderated and unmoderated usability tests on prototypes and live products
Design and analyse surveys with tools such as Qualtrics
Turn notes and recordings into themes and clear insights
Present findings as short reports and readouts that teams act on
Work with product managers, designers and engineers to set research priorities
Use basic statistics to read survey and test results
Read and adjust designs and prototypes in Figma
Pair qualitative findings with experiment results
Use product analytics to pick who and what to study
Include users with disabilities and test with assistive technology

certifications.why: Beginner course that covers research basics alongside design
